_doc: mover_alert config (read every loop tick). See mover_alert.py docstring. live=false keeps the launchd job dry even with OID_MOVER_MODE=live.
_doc_wall_cross_own_debounce: false = spec (one alert per ticker per direction per 30 min, A and B share). true = a wall cross gets its own 30-min key so it can fire right after a 3% move alert.
_doc_walls: Trigger B only uses walls younger than walls_max_age_min. 10/20: the mini FA caches were fresh only for NVDA (others 10/09-10/19), so B was effectively NVDA-only until the box focus-refresh writes fresh levels for all names.
_doc_live: live=false: job runs and logs to ~/oid-desk/state/mover-alert/alerts.jsonl but does not POST. Flip to true once the event-wake routine forwards mover_alert (read every tick, no restart).
_doc_volume: 10/20 replay: 45 alerts across 23 names by 7:55 AM PT at 3%/30m (cap raised 40->80). Raise move_pct or per_symbol_move_pct if too chatty.
_doc_wall_debounce: 2026-10-20 (Jeffrey, after QQQ 719 put-wall ping-pong 11:25/11:28): a wall cross alerts only on a confirmed side change = 2 consecutive 1-min closes >= wall_buffer_pct beyond the wall, or a 5-min close beyond it; 20-min cooldown per ticker per wall; re-cross back the other way within 60 min suppressed; (wall3, 12:10 PM PT) fires only if move off the 30-min high/low >= 0.5% AND (1-min rvol >= 1.5x OR 5-min rvol >= 1.2x), else suppressed. Suppressed crosses -> state/mover-alert/wall-suppressed.jsonl. 3% move alerts unchanged.
